title: A Word from Pastor
text: This week, I want to encourage every one of you: your presence in this church family matters more than you know. Keep showing up, keep believing, and keep bringing your whole heart to Jesus.

title: A Word from Pastor
text: Faith is not the absence of questions — it's bringing your questions to God instead of away from Him. Wherever you are this week, bring it all to Him.

title: A Word from Pastor
text: I'm praying for our church family today, that we'd love one another well and carry each other's burdens the way Christ carries ours.

title: A Word from Pastor
text: Thank you for being faithful — in worship, in giving, in serving. It doesn't go unnoticed by God, and it doesn't go unnoticed by me either.
